data.title: 佐天泪子 · 这一袋可以做晚饭
data.description: 周末菜市里，泪子把一颗熟番茄放进纸袋，又低头数了数。她已经想好晚饭要做什么，顺手把袋口折得平平整整。
data.promptProse: At a small vegetable market, Ruiko wears a cream blouse and moss-green pinafore dress. She lowers a ripe tomato into a paper shopping bag, smiling as she checks the vegetables inside. Daylight filters through the stall awning onto the produce baskets.
data.animaCaption: One tomato is held just above the open paper bag; the rest stay in the stall basket.
data.action: 把挑好的番茄放进纸袋
